incompatibleRuntime.title: This system isn't supported
incompatibleRuntime.description: mu opened, but its local service can't run on this Linux version. Upgrade to a supported Linux distribution, then restart mu.

incompleteInstallation.title: The mu installation is incomplete
incompleteInstallation.description: This installation is missing required files, so mu's local service can't start. Download and reinstall the latest version of mu. If the problem returns after reinstalling, check whether security or antivirus software quarantined mu's files.
incompleteInstallation.runtimeComponentDescription: This installation is missing required runtime components, so {{resource}} can't start. Reinstall the latest version of mu. If it still happens after reinstalling, check whether security or antivirus software quarantined mu's components.

packageArchitectureMismatch.title: Wrong mu package for this Mac
packageArchitectureMismatch.description: This mu package is for {{packageArch}}, but this Mac is {{deviceArch}}. Download and install the {{expectedArch}} package instead.

dataMigration.title: Couldn't migrate local data
dataMigration.description: mu opened, but its local service stopped while setting up local data. Reinstalling mu probably won't fix this. The app log shows where the database migration stopped.

databaseNewerThanApp.title: A newer version of mu is required
databaseNewerThanApp.description: Your local data was created by a newer version of mu, and this version can't open it. Update mu to the latest version to continue — your data is intact, and no reinstall or data reset is needed.
databaseNewerThanApp.descriptionWithVersion: Your local data was created by a version of mu newer than the one installed now (v{{currentVersion}}), so this version can't open it. Update mu to the latest version to continue — your data is intact, and no reinstall or data reset is needed.

localDataRepair.title: Couldn't repair local data
localDataRepair.description: mu opened, but its local service stopped while preparing local data such as assistant and agent records. Reinstalling mu probably won't fix this. The app log shows which data couldn't be prepared.

startupDirectory.title: Work or log folder unavailable
startupDirectory.description: mu opened, but its local service couldn't start because the configured work or log folder is missing, unavailable or blocked by permissions. Check that these folders exist and are writable, then restart mu.

recoverableDatabaseCorruption.title: Local data is corrupted
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.description: mu's local database is corrupted, so startup can't continue. mu can back up the old database and create a new one to finish starting. Past conversations won't be shown, but the old database is kept as a backup file.
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.rebuildFailed: Couldn't back up and rebuild the database

confirmDialog.title: Rebuild the database?
confirmDialog.content: This backs up the corrupted database and creates a new, empty one. Past conversations won't be shown (the old database is kept as a backup file). Continue?

transientConcurrentStartup.title: mu is starting up
transientConcurrentStartup.description: Another instance of mu was still using the local data when this window opened. This is temporary and your data is safe — no reinstall is needed. Wait a moment and try again, or restart mu.

pendingSlow.title: Starting up
pendingSlow.description: The local service is starting. If it doesn't respond after a while, quit and reopen the app.

exited.title: Startup didn't complete
exited.description: The local service couldn't finish starting and has exited. Restart the app; if this keeps happening, check the app log.

portReportTimeout.title: Startup timed out
portReportTimeout.description: The local service didn't finish starting in time. Restart the app; if this keeps happening, check the app log.

startupFailed.title: Startup failed
startupFailed.description: The local service couldn't start. Restart the app; if this keeps happening, check the app log.

hints.try_hive: This looks hard: if the cause is unknown or a direct attempt fails, use the hive.
hints.try_delegate: This splits into independent parts: consider handing them to subagents in parallel.
